name: ste-refine
description: Rewrites each typed prompt with the ASD-STE100 skill and lets you accept, edit or deny the rewrite before it is sent

model.title: Rewrite model
model.description: The model that rewrites the prompt, pinned to a version

skillSource.title: Skill source
skillSource.description: bundled: the skill copy in this mod. project: .claude/skills/asd-ste100 in the project you run in (use only for projects you trust)

mode.title: Rewrite mode
mode.description: strict: apply every STE rule. pragmatic: keep technical nouns and project terms, and allow sentences of up to 25 words
